full_parallel_row.english: All of this is caused by the extraordinary circumstances of the particular time and place, for generally speaking it never happens this way: there is nothing at all about the sun that can feel cold, and nothing about the moon that can feel hot. This too is a fact, for there does not exist on the sun any case of that substance we call "covered space." When the text of the Essence of Eloquence was taught to members of ACI by Geshe Tupten Rinchen at Sera Mey Tibetan Monastery, he took great pains to point out that it is not correct—as some Western scholars have stated—that Je Tsongkapa himself adhered to the tenets of the Mind-Only School. The following selection to show that he follows, of course, the beliefs of the Consequence group is taken from the concluding pages of our root text [ACIP electronic text S5396, ff. 112a-112b].
